case.summary: The transaction of $100.07 was allowed and the case was closed as legitimate. Evidence shows the device profile is new but only 8% of similar alerts were fraud and past alerts on that device were mostly cleared, indicating a genuine customer. The model scored the transaction 0.54, which is a weak signal and below the threshold for blocking. The fraud probability was 0.05, well under the 0.15 limit. Because the case rested on a single weak signal, the policy (R1) required verification rather than a block, so the transaction was allowed and the case closed with no fraud finding.
